t: 亨德里克·隆克所率领的荷兰部队在本来要成为荷兰巴西一部分的地方攻克了奥林达.
te: Dutch forces led by Hendrick Lonck capture Olinda in what was to become part of Dutch Brazil.
dz: 亨德里克·隆克所率领的荷兰部队在本来要成为荷兰巴西一部分的地方攻克了奥林达.
de: Dutch forces led by Hendrick Lonck capture Olinda in what was to become part of Dutch Brazil.

t: 古斯塔夫·阿道夫率领的四千瑞典军队登陆德国波美拉尼亚。
te: Four thousand Swedish troops under Gustavus Adolphus land in Pomerania, Germany.
dz: 三十年战争：古斯塔夫·阿道夫率领的四千瑞典军队登陆德国波美拉尼亚。
de: Thirty Years' War: Four thousand Swedish troops under Gustavus Adolphus land in Pomerania, Germany.

t: 葡萄牙军队被坎地王国在斯里兰卡的兰德尼韦拉战役所击败.
te: Portuguese forces are defeated by the Kingdom of Kandy at the Battle of Randeniwela in Sri Lanka.
dz: 葡萄牙军队被坎地王国在斯里兰卡的兰德尼韦拉战役所击败.
de: Portuguese forces are defeated by the Kingdom of Kandy at the Battle of Randeniwela in Sri Lanka.

t: 北美马萨诸塞州波士顿市成立。
te: The city of Boston, Massachusetts, is founded in North America.
dz: 北美马萨诸塞州波士顿市成立。
de: The city of Boston, Massachusetts, is founded in North America.

t: 苏格兰的弗伦德鲁克城堡,弗伦德鲁克特的詹姆斯·克赖克通的故居被烧毁.
te: Frendraught Castle in Scotland, the home of James Crichton of Frendraught, burns down.
dz: 苏格兰的弗伦德鲁克城堡,弗伦德鲁克特的詹姆斯·克赖克通的故居被烧毁.
